key: Oh, only........ Between that and the powder I dropped, I'm going to need some more pollen and scents to work with........

ja: あ、ただ……さっき落としてしまった粉と合わせて、もう少し花粉と香りの材料が必要になりそうです……

key: I don't suppose you'd be willing to help out a little more, would you?

en: I'll just need to see a few Pokémon. Any Pokémon that has a flower on its body should do!

key: I think I'll need about........ three more unique species?
en: I think I'll need about........ three more unique species?

key: If you can help me find them, I promise you'll not regret it!
en: If you can help me find them, I promise you'll not regret it!
ja: 見つけるのを手伝ってくださったら、後悔はさせません、約束します!

key: LAURA: I don't suppose you've found any floral Pokémon for me, have you?

ja: わたしの名前はローラです。はじめまして!

key: ........Or, for that matter, to meet anyone.
en: ........Or, for that matter, to meet anyone.
ja: ……というより、誰かに会うこと自体、久しぶりです。

key: It's, um, been a while since I was allowed to be out unattended........
en: It's, um, been a while since I was allowed to be out unattended........
ja: その、一人で外出を許されたのも、久しぶりで……

key: To be honest, I find the city a little overwhelming........
en: To be honest, I find the city a little overwhelming........
ja: 正直に言うと、この街は少し圧倒されてしまいます……

key: It's crowded and lonely all at the same time,
en: It's crowded and lonely all at the same time,
ja: 人でいっぱいなのに、どこか孤独で、

key: And that's to say nothing of the cleanliness........ or lack thereof........
en: And that's to say nothing of the cleanliness........ or lack thereof........
ja: 清潔さについては……言うまでもありません……

key: I don't suppose you've found any floral Pokémon for me, have you?
en: I don't suppose you've found any floral Pokémon for me, have you?
ja: わたしのために、花のポケモンを見つけてくださったりは、しませんよね?

key: LAURA: We just need three Pokémon with a flower anywhere on their body. I can make the rest of the mix from there.
en: LAURA: We just need three Pokémon with a flower anywhere on their body. I can make the rest of the mix from there.
ja: ローラ: 体のどこかに花がついているポケモンが、あと3匹必要です。そこから先の調合は、わたしが仕上げますね。

key: An unopened bud or bulb won't do. I'll need the full- fledged scent to be able to capture it!
en: An unopened bud or bulb won't do. I'll need the full- fledged scent to be able to capture it!
ja: まだ開いていないつぼみや球根では駄目です。香りを捉えるには、しっかりと咲いたものが必要なんです!

key: Come to think of it, I did see one gentleman passing by with a Comfey in tow.
en: Come to think of it, I did see one gentleman passing by with a Comfey in tow.
ja: そういえば、キュワワーを連れた男の人が通りかかるのを見かけました。

key: He seemed ill-suited for it. Perhaps he could be persuaded to let us borrow it?
en: He seemed ill-suited for it. Perhaps he could be persuaded to let us borrow it?
ja: あまり似合ってなかったので、頼めば貸してもらえるかもしれません。

key: If I'm not mistaken, he said something about heading off to the North Peridot Ward.
en: If I'm not mistaken, he said something about heading off to the North Peridot Ward.
ja: たしか、北ペリドット区に向かうって言ってた気がします。

key: LAURA: Oh, an Ivysaur?
en: LAURA: Oh, an Ivysaur?

key: While it doesn't quite have a proper flower yet........
en: While it doesn't quite have a proper flower yet........
ja: まだ、きちんとした花はついていませんけど……

key: There is still the beginning of one, right?
en: There is still the beginning of one, right?
ja: その始まりは、もうありますよね?

key: With how much pollen Venusaur can produce, thank goodness its bulb is still closed........
en: With how much pollen Venusaur can produce, thank goodness its bulb is still closed........
ja: フシギバナがどれだけの花粉を出すか考えると、まだつぼみが閉じているのは、ありがたいことです……

key: Did you know? An Ivysaur's bulb tends to swell and bloom through increased exposure to sunlight-- just a little bit of nurturing and kindness.
en: Did you know? An Ivysaur's bulb tends to swell and bloom through increased exposure to sunlight-- just a little bit of nurturing and kindness.
ja: ご存じでしたか? フシギソウの球根は、日光をたくさん浴びることで膨らんで花開くんです――ほんの少しの世話と優しさで。

key: People are the same way, don't you think?
en: People are the same way, don't you think?

key: Grow strong, little one.
en: Grow strong, little one.
ja: 強く育つのよ、この子。

key: LAURA: Oh, I've always loved the fragrance of Venusaur's flower.
en: LAURA: Oh, I've always loved the fragrance of Venusaur's flower.
ja: ローラ: あら、フシギバナの花の香りは、昔からずっと大好きなんです。

key: I've heard it's like petrichor; a bit different to everyone.
en: I've heard it's like petrichor; a bit different to everyone.
ja: 雨上がりの土の匂いに似てるって聞きますけど、人によって少しずつ違うそうです。

key: And you'll never find a stronger heart note, what with how much pollen they produce. It's quite a--
en: And you'll never find a stronger heart note, what with how much pollen they produce. It's quite a--

ja: ハックション!!! でも、さっきの粉が――

ja: ハックション、ハックション!!!

key: Make it stop........
en: Make it stop........
ja: 止めてください……

key: LAURA: Oh, a Gloom!
en: LAURA: Oh, a Gloom!
ja: ローラ: あら、クサイハナ!

key: Most people plug their noses when they see a Gloom, but the honey it produces is quite miraculous!
en: Most people plug their noses when they see a Gloom, but the honey it produces is quite miraculous!
ja: たいていの人は、クサイハナを見ると鼻をつまんでしまいますけど、この子が作る蜜は本当に驚くべきものなんです!

key: Since honey usually comes from Bug Types, when coming from a floral organism instead, it can have a lot of unique enzymatic properties!
en: Since honey usually comes from Bug Types, when coming from a floral organism instead, it can have a lot of unique enzymatic properties!
ja: 蜜は普通むしタイプのポケモンから採れるものですが、花の生き物から採れる場合は、独特な酵素の性質をたくさん持っていることがあるんです!

key: It doesn't always smell perfectly sweet to us........ but I think it's been unfairly maligned.
en: It doesn't always smell perfectly sweet to us........ but I think it's been unfairly maligned.
ja: わたしたちには、いつも甘く香るとは限りませんけど……不当に悪く言われすぎだと思います。

key: If you can look past the sharp edge of the odor, you'll see there's a wonderful sugar scent under there just waiting to be appreciated.
en: If you can look past the sharp edge of the odor, you'll see there's a wonderful sugar scent under there just waiting to be appreciated.
ja: その刺すような匂いの奥を見てあげれば、認められるのを待っている、素敵な甘い香りがちゃんとあるんです。

key: Isn't that right, little Gloom?
en: Isn't that right, little Gloom?
ja: ねえ、クサイハナ?

key: You were just waiting for someone who could really treasure you, weren't you?
en: You were just waiting for someone who could really treasure you, weren't you?
ja: あなたも、本当に大切にしてくれる誰かを、ずっと待ってたんでしょう?

key: LAURA: Ah, Vileplume. Was bringing me something so strong perhaps meant to be some sort of prank, \PN?
en: LAURA: Ah, Vileplume. Was bringing me something so strong perhaps meant to be some sort of prank, \PN?
ja: ローラ: あら、ラフレシア。こんなに強烈な子を連れてくるなんて、\PN、もしかしていたずらのつもりですか?

key: But I have every intention of rising to the occasion!
en: But I have every intention of rising to the occasion!
ja: でも、しっかり応えてみせるつもりです!

key: Haven't you ever wondered exactly why flowers like these can smell so strongly?
en: Haven't you ever wondered exactly why flowers like these can smell so strongly?
ja: こういう花が、どうしてこんなに強く香るのか、不思議に思ったことはありませんか?

key: To us, it's repulsive. So you'd think it might make a good repellant........
en: To us, it's repulsive. So you'd think it might make a good repellant........
ja: わたしたちにとっては不快な匂いですから、忌避剤にぴったりだと思うかもしれませんが……

key: But in reality, it smells that way to attract other kinds of creatures!
en: But in reality, it smells that way to attract other kinds of creatures!
ja: でも実際には、他の生き物をひきつけるために、こういう香りを放っているんです!

key: This will make a wonderful addition to an alluring array!
en: This will make a wonderful addition to an alluring array!
ja: これは、魅惑的な調合の素敵な仲間になりますね!

key: LAURA: Bellossom? Each has a distinct aroma, like the medley of a fresh garden.
en: LAURA: Bellossom? Each has a distinct aroma, like the medley of a fresh garden.
ja: ローラ: キレイハナですか? 一匹一匹に違った香りがあって、まるで咲きたての庭の花束のようです。

key: You know, they say that the most beautiful of Bellossom come from the smelliest of Gloom.
en: You know, they say that the most beautiful of Bellossom come from the smelliest of Gloom.
ja: 一番美しいキレイハナは、一番匂いのきついクサイハナから生まれるって言われてるんですよ。

key: There's something wonderful, I think.
en: There's something wonderful, I think.
ja: それって、素敵なことだと思うんです。

key: That we have to be true to ourselves no matter what-- even if others don't understand or are put off.
en: That we have to be true to ourselves no matter what-- even if others don't understand or are put off.
ja: 何があっても、自分に正直でいなくちゃいけないってこと――たとえ他の人に理解してもらえなくても、遠ざけられても。

key: I'm so glad this one was able to flourish in the end. Let's make a grand enfleurage of it.
en: I'm so glad this one was able to flourish in the end.  Let's make a grand enfleurage of it.
ja: この子が最後にはこんなに花開いてくれて、本当にうれしいです。じっくりと、アンフルラージュを作りましょう。

key: LAURA: Oh, Meganium has quite a large flower-- Yes, this should be perfect!
en: LAURA: Oh, Meganium has quite a large flower-- Yes, this should be perfect!
ja: ローラ: あら、メガニウムはとても大きな花をつけてますね――ええ、これは完璧です!

key: Such vibrant colors, too.
en: Such vibrant colors, too.
ja: 色もとても鮮やかで。

key: It’s quite fragrant, almost like morning dew--- A hint of cherry, too, perhaps?
en: It’s quite fragrant, almost like morning dew--- A hint of cherry, too, perhaps?
ja: とても香り高くて、まるで朝露のよう――かすかに、サクランボの香りもするでしょうか?

key: A cherry heart note for a sweet and calming aroma.........
en: A cherry heart note for a sweet and calming aroma.........
ja: サクランボのハートノートが、甘く落ち着いた香りを作り出しますね……

key: Even just being around it for a short period of time is soothing.
en: Even just being around it for a short period of time is soothing.
ja: 少しそばにいるだけでも、心が落ち着きます。

key: Maybe I should find one for my sister.
en: Maybe I should find one for my sister.
ja: 妹にも一匹、見つけてあげようかしら。

en: It kind of looks like a dragon........ if you squint........?
ja: よく見ると……ちょっとドラゴンみたいに見えますね……?

key: LAURA: We’d often catch view of the Skiploom riding the wind high in the sky back home.
en: LAURA: We’d often catch view of the Skiploom riding the wind high in the sky back home.
ja: ローラ: 故郷では、ポポッコが空高く風に乗っているのを、よく見かけたものです。

key: Jumpluff too, though by the time it evolves, there's no flower to use.
en: Jumpluff too, though by the time it evolves, there's no flower to use.
ja: ワタッコもですけど、進化する頃には、もう使える花が残っていないんですよね。

key: Strange how they only bloom for one stage of their lives.
en: Strange how they only bloom for one stage of their lives.
ja: 生涯のうち、たった一段階しか花を咲かせないなんて、不思議です。

key: It smells almost fresh cut grass-- A rare favorite head note.
en: It smells almost fresh cut grass-- A rare favorite head note.
ja: 刈りたての草のような香りで――珍しく、お気に入りのヘッドノートです。

key: You know, I’ve never witnessed it firsthand, but I’ve heard they often respond to temperature.
en: You know, I’ve never witnessed it firsthand, but I’ve heard they often respond to temperature.
ja: 実際に見たことはないんですけど、気温に反応することが多いって聞きます。

key: Perhaps the intensity would change with heat or cold?
en: Perhaps the intensity would change with heat or cold?
ja: 暑さや寒さで、香りの強さが変わったりするのかもしれませんね。

key: Oh-- but don't worry, little one! I won't be using any super-effective moves on you!
en: Oh-- but don't worry, little one! I won't be using any super-effective moves on you!
ja: あ――でも心配しないでね、あなたに効果ばつぐんの技なんて使いませんから!

key: LAURA: Oh, I do love Sunflora~

ja: ローラ: あら、キマワリって本当に大好きです~

key: The aroma is subtle, with lingering notes of honey and summertime zephyrs.
en: The aroma is subtle, with lingering notes of honey and summertime zephyrs.
ja: 香りはほのかで、蜂蜜と夏のそよ風の余韻が残ります。

key: They’re so bright and kind-- always seeking out the sun and its light.
en: They’re so bright and kind-- always seeking out the sun and its light.
ja: とても明るくて優しくて――いつも太陽の光を追いかけています。

key: Then again, would we ever know, with such a cute face, if one was aggravated?
en: Then again, would we ever know, with such a cute face, if one was aggravated?
ja: それにしても、こんなにかわいい顔で怒っていても、わたしたち分かるのかしら?

key: Perhaps smiling through the frustration is its real skill.
en: Perhaps smiling through the frustration is its real skill.
ja: 苛立ちを笑顔で乗り越えるのが、この子の本当の得意技なのかもしれませんね。

key: Oh, wait........ From what I hear, that's just customer service.
en: Oh, wait........ From what I hear, that's just customer service.
ja: あ、待って……聞いた話では、それはただの接客業みたいなものだそうです。

key: LAURA: Oh, Cherrim. Even overcast, it smells just as sweet as when it’s in full bloom........
en: LAURA: Oh, Cherrim. Even overcast, it smells just as sweet as when it’s in full bloom........
ja: ローラ: あら、チェリムですね。曇りの日でも、満開の時と変わらず甘く香ります……

key: It should make for a strong head note-- I do love the fragrance of cherry blossoms.
en: It should make for a strong head note-- I do love the fragrance of cherry blossoms.
ja: きっと力強いヘッドノートになりますね――桜の香り、本当に大好きなんです。

key: But I won't be able to catch the scent the same way, so I'll need you to peek out and say "Hello"!
en: But I won't be able to catch the scent the same way, so I'll need you to peek out and say "Hello"!
ja: でも、このままだと同じようには香りを捉えられないので、顔を出して「こんにちは」って言ってもらわなくちゃ!

key: I don't suppose you'll accept the warmth of a sunny disposition as second to sunlight itself?
en: I don't suppose you'll accept the warmth of a sunny disposition as second to sunlight itself?
ja: 日光そのものの次に、明るい気性のぬくもりを受け入れてもらえたりしませんか?

key: Oh-- hello, sweetie! Thank you for being so cooperative!
en: Oh-- hello, sweetie! Thank you for being so cooperative!
ja: あ――こんにちは、かわいい子! 協力してくれてありがとう!

key: Beautiful too! This won't take but a moment.
en: Beautiful too! This won't take but a moment.
ja: とってもきれいですね! すぐに終わりますから。

key: LAURA: Oh! That is a flower, isn’t it?
en: LAURA: Oh! That is a flower, isn’t it?
ja: ローラ: あら! それは花、ですよね?

key: Even a Pokémon that makes its home in such an unconventional habitat finds its own way to bloom.
en: Even a Pokémon that makes its home in such an unconventional habitat finds its own way to bloom.
ja: こんな型破りな環境を住処にしているポケモンでも、ちゃんと自分なりの花の咲かせ方があるんですね。

key: We’d best be careful to avoid its spines, though........
en: We’d best be careful to avoid its spines, though........
ja: とはいえ、トゲには気をつけたほうが良さそうです……

key: It must be dangerous in the desert.
en: It must be dangerous in the desert.
ja: 砂漠では、きっと危険なんでしょうね。

key: They’re filled with nutrients, so I guess it has to guard its seeds carefully.
en: They’re filled with nutrients, so I guess it has to guard its seeds carefully.
ja: 栄養がたっぷり詰まっているから、種を大事に守らなくちゃいけないんでしょうね。

key: It smells of honeysuckle. I wonder if it's strong enough to make a base note of?
en: It smells of honeysuckle. I wonder if it's strong enough to make a base note of?
ja: スイカズラのような香りがしますね。ベースノートにできるくらい、強い香りなのかしら?

key: I’ll do my best to not get-- Ouch!
en: I’ll do my best to not get-- Ouch!
ja: 刺されないように気をつけて――痛っ!
……その――さ、刺されちゃいました……

key: Sorry, little friend! That must feel awkward for you, too!
en: Sorry, little friend! That must feel awkward for you, too!
ja: ごめんなさいね! あなたも、きっと気まずいわよね!

key: LAURA: Oh........ I can’t help but be entranced by Roselia.
en: LAURA: Oh........ I can’t help but be entranced by Roselia.
ja: ローラ: あら……ロゼリアには、どうしても心を奪われてしまいます。

key: They’re fascinating-- an exercise in observing how well a Trainer cares for their Pokémon.
en: They’re fascinating-- an exercise in observing how well a Trainer cares for their Pokémon.
ja: 興味深い子たちです――トレーナーがどれだけポケモンの世話をしているか、よく分かる指標になるんです。

key: The healthier a Roselia is, the stronger and more fragrant its aroma.
en: The healthier a Roselia is, the stronger and more fragrant its aroma.
ja: ロゼリアが健康であればあるほど、香りは強く、豊かになります。

key: This one has quite a pleasant fragrance........ Roses in the mid-spring morning.
en: This one has quite a pleasant fragrance........ Roses in the mid-spring morning.
ja: この子はとても心地良い香りですね……晩春の朝のバラのようです。

key: It must have been taken good care of, to evolve so well.
en: It must have been taken good care of, to evolve so well.
ja: ここまでしっかり進化しているなんて、きっと大切に育てられたんですね。

key: Naturally, of course!
en: Naturally, of course!
ja: もちろん、当然です!

key: After all, who wouldn't love to care for such an adorable child like Budew?
en: After all, who wouldn't love to care for such an adorable child like Budew?
ja: だって、スボミーみたいなかわいい子のお世話、誰だって好きになりますよね?

key: Do continue to treat it with the same care, yes?
en: Do continue to treat it with the same care, yes?
ja: これからも、同じように大切にしてあげてくださいね?

key: LAURA: A Roserade........ Graceful and sweet, yet deadly if not treated correctly.
en: LAURA: A Roserade........ Graceful and sweet, yet deadly if not treated correctly.
ja: ローラ: ロズレイドですか……優雅で甘い、でも扱いを誤れば命取りになります。

key: I can't help but be a little jealous, haha~
en: I can't help but be a little jealous, haha~
ja: ちょっと、うらやましくなっちゃいますね、ふふ~

key: Raising these proud Pokémon takes proper skill-- and caution to avoid its poison.
en: Raising these proud Pokémon takes proper skill-- and caution to avoid its poison.
ja: この誇り高いポケモンを育てるには、確かな技術が必要です――それに、毒を避ける注意も。

key: In this case, it equates toxicity with aroma........
en: In this case, it equates toxicity with aroma........
ja: この子の場合、毒性は香りと比例していて……

key: The more pleasant it smells, the more poisonous its toxin.
en: The more pleasant it smells, the more poisonous its toxin.
ja: 香りが心地良ければ良いほど、毒はより強くなるんです。

key: This one smells quite sweet, so........
en: This one smells quite sweet, so........
ja: この子はとても甘く香るので……

key: I'll be careful, okay?
en: I'll be careful, okay?
ja: 気をつけますね?

key: LAURA: Did you know that Flabébé get their power from the flowers directly?
en: LAURA: Did you know that Flabébé get their power from the flowers directly?
ja: ローラ: フラベベは、花から直接力を得ているって、ご存じでしたか?

key: They can't do much until they find a home to tend and take care of.
en: They can't do much until they find a home to tend and take care of.
ja: 世話をして大切にする花を見つけるまでは、あまり多くのことができないんです。

key: But it's not as if the flower itself has that power either........
en: But it's not as if the flower itself has that power either........
ja: でも、花そのものにその力があるわけでもなくて……

key: The real magic must be in the nurturing relationship between them.
en: The real magic must be in the nurturing relationship between them.
ja: 本当の魔法は、二つの間で育まれる関係そのものにあるんでしょうね。

key: That's the kind of thing that I'll fall asleep smiling about.
en: That's the kind of thing that I'll fall asleep smiling about.
ja: そういうことを考えながら、笑顔で眠りにつけそうです。

key: Thanks for sharing your Flabébé with me!
en: Thanks for sharing your Flabébé with me!
ja: フラベベを見せてくれて、ありがとうございました!

key: LAURA: Oh, we’re quite alike, aren’t we, Floette?
en: LAURA: Oh, we’re quite alike, aren’t we, Floette?
ja: ローラ: あら、わたしたち、けっこう似てますね、フラエッテ?

key: I carry around my own flowers, too-- only in my hair rather than my hands.
en: I carry around my own flowers, too-- only in my hair rather than my hands.
ja: わたしも、自分の花をいつも持ち歩いてるんです――手ではなく、髪に挿してますけど。

key: I’ve heard that they can make fully withered flowers bloom right back into health.
en: I’ve heard that they can make fully withered flowers bloom right back into health.
ja: すっかり枯れてしまった花でも、また元気に咲かせられるって聞きます。

key: Now if only we were alike in that sense, too........
en: Now if only we were alike in that sense, too........
ja: そういう意味でも似ていたら、良かったんですけど……

key: LAURA: Oh! It doesn’t just have one flower, or two or three-- It's a whole bushel!
en: LAURA: Oh! It doesn’t just have one flower, or two or three-- It's a whole bushel!
ja: ローラ: あら! 花が1本や2本、3本どころじゃなくて――まるごと花束ですね!

key: Between the variance in colors and all of the flowers in their bouquet, I feel I could make nearly infinite enfleurages just with one alone.
en: Between the variance in colors and all of the flowers in their bouquet, I feel I could make nearly infinite enfleurages just with one alone.
ja: 色の違いと、花束の中の花の多さを考えると、この子一匹だけで、ほとんど無限にアンフルラージュが作れそうです。

key: I think people are like that too.
en: I think people are like that too.
ja: 人も、そういうところがあると思うんです。

key: You can always find another angle of them-- another way to experience them, if you look hard enough.
en: You can always find another angle of them-- another way to experience them, if you look hard enough.
ja: しっかり目を向ければ、いつだって別の角度から――別の感じ方を見つけられます。

key: I don't think I'll have to look very hard here at all, but it would still be good to have more samples!
en: I don't think I'll have to look very hard here at all, but it would still be good to have more samples!
ja: この子については、そんなに苦労しなくてもよさそうですけど、サンプルはもっとあったほうがいいですね!

key: Think of it as giving me more colors to paint with.
en: Think of it as giving me more colors to paint with.
ja: わたしに、絵の具の色を増やしてくれるようなものだと思ってください。

key: It's a little more fun that way, isn't it?
en: It's a little more fun that way, isn't it?
ja: そのほうが、ちょっと楽しいですよね?

key: LAURA: A........ Shaymin?
en: LAURA: A........ Shaymin?
ja: ローラ: え……シェイミ、ですか?

key: Wherever did you find something like this, \PN?
en: Wherever did you find something like this, \PN?
ja: こんな子、いったいどこで見つけたんですか、\PN?

key: I’ve never seen one-- only stories and legends.
en: I’ve never seen one-- only stories and legends.
ja: 実物を見たことはなくて――物語や伝説の中だけの存在でした。

key: But there is a flower-- quite a famous one, in fact.
en: But there is a flower-- quite a famous one, in fact.
ja: でも、花はちゃんとありますね――それも、かなり有名なものが。

key: I imagine to use this anywhere that wasn’t a starring note would be a disservice........
en: I imagine to use this anywhere that wasn’t a starring note would be a disservice........
ja: これを主役の香り以外に使うなんて、きっと失礼にあたると思います……

key: Thank you, \PN.
en: Thank you, \PN.
ja: ありがとうございます、\PN。

key: You already knew my gratitude for your assistance, but no harm in communicating it once more, right?
en: You already knew my gratitude for your assistance, but no harm in communicating it once more, right?
ja: 手伝ってくださったことへの感謝は、もうお伝えしていましたけど、もう一度伝えても、いいですよね?

key: LAURA: ........Well, it’s not a flower, but........
en: LAURA: ........Well, it’s not a flower, but........
ja: ローラ: ……そうですね、花ではありませんけど……

key: It shouldn’t be any sort of challenge with this little one.
en: It shouldn’t be any sort of challenge with this little one.
ja: この子となら、難しいことにはならなそうです。

key: It would be a shame if the Fragrance Pokémon was unable to help us with our own fragrance, don’t you think?
en: It would be a shame if the Fragrance Pokémon was unable to help us with our own fragrance, don’t you think?
ja: 「香りポケモン」が、わたしたちの香り作りを手伝えないなんて、残念だと思いませんか?

key: Aromatisse are rather flexible, too-- able to change its own aroma at a whim to its advantage as both a repellant and attractor.
en: Aromatisse are rather flexible, too-- able to change its own aroma at a whim to its advantage as both a repellant and attractor.
ja: フレフワンはとても柔軟で――自分の香りを気ままに変えて、忌避にも誘引にも役立てられるんです。

key: Let's see if we can replicate that!
en: Let's see if we can replicate that!
ja: それを再現できるか、試してみましょう!

key: LAURA: Oh, is this that Comfey from earlier?
en: LAURA: Oh, is this that Comfey from earlier?
ja: ローラ: あら、これはさっきのキュワワーですか?

key: Hello, little one. Those boys put you through quite an ordeal, didn't they?
en: Hello, little one. Those boys put you through quite an ordeal, didn't they?
ja: こんにちは、あなた。あの男の子たちに、大変な思いをさせられたんでしょう?

key: They seemed to be in a rather desperate way, backs up against the wall,
en: They seemed to be in a rather desperate way, backs up against the wall,
ja: あの子たち、追い詰められて、必死な様子でした、

key: Looking for any help or escape in a world that tells them they should've already had it all figured out........
en: Looking for any help or escape in a world that tells them they should've already had it all figured out........
ja: もうすべて分かっているべきだと言われる世界の中で、助けや逃げ場を探していたんですね……

key: Being a boy must be difficult.
en: Being a boy must be difficult.
ja: 男の子でいるのも、きっと大変なんでしょうね。

key: My older sister always said if she'd had a choice, she wouldn't have thought twice.
en: My older sister always said if she'd had a choice, she wouldn't have thought twice.
ja: わたしの姉はいつも、選べるなら迷わず違う道を選ぶって言ってました。

key: I could never, though.
en: I could never, though.
ja: でも、わたしには無理でした。

key: I hope you won't hold it against them.
en: I hope you won't hold it against them.
ja: 彼らを恨まないでいてくれると、うれしいです。

key: They were looking to you for something you couldn't give them.
en: They were looking to you for something you couldn't give them.
ja: あの子たちは、あなたが与えられないものを、あなたに求めていたんです。

key: Not everyone is like that. This Trainer will take better care of you from now on, okay?
en: Not everyone is like that. This Trainer will take better care of you from now on, okay?
ja: みんながみんな、そうじゃありません。このトレーナーが、これからはもっと大事にしてくれますからね?

key: ........There, all done.
en: ........There, all done.
ja: ……はい、これで終わりです。

key: Only, I'm curious about one thing.
en: Only, I'm curious about one thing.
ja: ただ、ひとつだけ気になることが。

key: The flowers a Comfey holds will naturally vary depending on what it picks up.
en: The flowers a Comfey holds will naturally vary depending on what it picks up.
ja: キュワワーが持つ花は、何を拾うかによって自然と変わるものです。

key: With how the boys were acting before, I was sure that this Comfey had been forced to collect some dire material, but these........
en: With how the boys were acting before, I was sure that this Comfey had been forced to collect some dire material, but these........
ja: さっきのあの子たちの様子を見て、このキュワワーは何か酷いものを集めさせられたんだろうと思っていたんですけど、これは……

key: These are just normal flowers.
en: These are just normal flowers.
ja: ただの、普通の花ですね。

key: What could have possessed them to act such a way?
en: What could have possessed them to act such a way?
ja: いったい何が、あの子たちをあんな行動に駆り立てたんでしょう?

key: Perhaps........
en: Perhaps........
ja: もしかすると……

key: Perhaps it's best if we don't think about it too hard.
en: Perhaps it's best if we don't think about it too hard.
ja: あまり深く考えないほうが、良いのかもしれません。

key: LAURA: Oh, you're not the same Comfey as from earlier, are you?
en: LAURA: Oh, you're not the same Comfey as from earlier, are you?
ja: ローラ: あら、さっきのキュワワーとは、違う子ですよね?

key: Regardless, you've got quite the eye for finding flowers, little one!
en: Regardless, you've got quite the eye for finding flowers, little one!
ja: それにしても、あなた、花を見つける目がありますね!

key: These are beautiful-- and there's so many, too!
en: These are beautiful-- and there's so many, too!
ja: とてもきれいで――しかも、こんなにたくさん!

key: You must be raising a very happy Comfey, \PN.
en: You must be raising a very happy Comfey, \PN.
ja: きっと、とても幸せなキュワワーを育てているんですね、\PN。

key: There's lots of variety for me to use here-- excellent for a unique scent.
en: There's lots of variety for me to use here-- excellent for a unique scent.
ja: 使える種類がたくさんあって――ユニークな香りを作るのにぴったりです。

key: I've always been interested in studying Comfey-- supposedly, once it attaches a flower to itself, the flower will never wither or wilt.
en: I've always been interested in studying Comfey-- supposedly, once it attaches a flower to itself, the flower will never wither or wilt.
ja: キュワワーの研究には、ずっと興味があったんです――一度花を身につけると、その花は決して枯れることも萎れることもないそうで。

key: Wouldn't that be nice to learn from?
en: Wouldn't that be nice to learn from?
ja: そこから学べることが、きっとありそうですよね?

key: LAURA: Um, \PN........
en: LAURA: Um, \PN........
ja: ローラ: あの、\PN……

key: When I said "any Pokémon with a flower on it", this isn't exactly what I........
en: When I said "any Pokémon with a flower on it", this isn't exactly what I........
ja: 「花をつけたポケモン」って言ったのは、その、こういう意味では……

key: Oh, well, nevermind. I suppose it does create a mist too, doesn't it?
en: Oh, well, nevermind. I suppose it does create a mist too, doesn't it?
ja: あ、いえ、いいんです。そういえば、この子も霧を作りますよね?

key: I tried once, to work with a Musharna's dream smoke,
en: I tried once, to work with a Musharna's dream smoke,
ja: 以前、ムシャーナの夢のけむりを使ってみたことがあるんですけど、

key: But I could never fully get rid of the, erm, side effects, no matter how I diluted it.
en: But I could never fully get rid of the, erm, side effects, no matter how I diluted it.
ja: どれだけ薄めても、その、副作用を完全に取り除くことはできませんでした。

key: But perhaps with this little one instead........
en: But perhaps with this little one instead........
ja: でも、この子でなら、もしかすると……

key: Why don't we find out?
en: Why don't we find out?
ja: 試してみましょうか?

key: LAURA: Gossifleur's pollen is more popular as tea than any part of it in perfume, but it should do as a nice soft heart note........
en: LAURA: Gossifleur's pollen is more popular as tea than any part of it in perfume, but it should do as a nice soft heart note........
ja: ローラ: ヒメンカの花粉は、香水よりもお茶として人気ですけど、優しいハートノートには十分なりそうです……

key: Gossifleur really are amazing, though.
en: Gossifleur really are amazing, though.
ja: でも、ヒメンカって本当にすごい子たちなんです。

key: When I was young, my sisters and I all caught a really bad cold.
en: When I was young, my sisters and I all caught a really bad cold.
ja: 小さい頃、姉妹みんなでひどい風邪をひいたことがあって。

key: Despite her sniffling, my older sister pumped herself up, went and wrangled a wild Gossifleur from our cove.
en: Despite her sniffling, my older sister pumped herself up, went and wrangled a wild Gossifleur from our cove.
ja: 鼻をすすりながらも、姉は気合いを入れて、入り江から野生のヒメンカを捕まえてきたんです。

key: We were going to try and make it into a healing tea, but we were all kids, and didn't know the first thing about herbal blends........
en: We were going to try and make it into a healing tea, but we were all kids, and didn't know the first thing about herbal blends........
ja: それで回復のお茶を作ろうとしたんですけど、みんな子どもだったので、薬草のブレンドなんてまるで分かっていなくて……

key: By the end of the night, the kitchen was covered in pollen, no one could stop sneezing, and all of us were definitely grounded.
en: By the end of the night, the kitchen was covered in pollen, no one could stop sneezing, and all of us were definitely grounded.
ja: 夜が終わる頃には、台所は花粉だらけ、誰もくしゃみが止まらなくて、みんな間違いなく外出禁止にされました。

key: But it turns out, the important part wasn't the tea anyway.
en: But it turns out, the important part wasn't the tea anyway.
ja: でも結局、大事なのはお茶そのものじゃなかったんです。

key: Even in the form of a hay fever mega-hazard, the healing properties come through!
en: Even in the form of a hay fever mega-hazard, the healing properties come through!
ja: 花粉症の大惨事という形であっても、回復の効果はちゃんと伝わってくるんですね!

key: It's just........ a lot more pleasant as a tea.
en: It's just........ a lot more pleasant as a tea.
ja: ただ……お茶にしたほうが、ずっと心地良いですけど。

key: LAURA: Oh, a Deerling!
en: LAURA: Oh, a Deerling!
ja: ローラ: あら、シキジカ!

key: I’ve heard their coats shift to match the seasons, but I’ve never seen one up close to witness it.
en: I’ve heard their coats shift to match the seasons, but I’ve never seen one up close to witness it.
ja: 毛並みが季節に合わせて変わるって聞きますけど、間近で見たことはなかったんです。

key: Dear me........ they’re so gentle, aren’t they?
en: Dear me........ they’re so gentle, aren’t they?
ja: まあ……本当に優しい子たちですね。

key: Just as delicate and sweet as the scent they emit!
en: Just as delicate and sweet as the scent they emit!
ja: 放つ香りと同じくらい、繊細で甘い子です!

key: I’ve heard they’re quite bold when it comes to intruding into gardens to eat what they please, though!
en: I’ve heard they’re quite bold when it comes to intruding into gardens to eat what they please, though!
ja: とはいえ、庭に入り込んで好き放題食べちゃうくらい、大胆だとも聞きますけど!

key: But maybe they simply just love flowers as much as I do........
en: But maybe they simply just love flowers as much as I do........
ja: でも、単に、わたしと同じくらい花が好きなだけなのかもしれません……

key: ........Or they love eating them........
en: ........Or they love eating them........
ja: ……それとも、食べるのが好きなだけなのかも……

key: I suppose I can't fault them for that, right?
en: I suppose I can't fault them for that, right?
ja: それを責めるわけにも、いきませんよね?

key: LAURA: This is a springtime Sawsbuck, isn’t it?
en: LAURA: This is a springtime Sawsbuck, isn’t it?
ja: ローラ: これは、春のメブキジカ、ですよね?

key: They tend to migrate along with the seasons, so I’ve only seen the summer ones at our home.
en: They tend to migrate along with the seasons, so I’ve only seen the summer ones at our home.
ja: 季節に合わせて移動する子たちなので、故郷では夏のメブキジカしか見たことがなかったんです。

key: I’ve heard they migrate as far up as Route 4, though!
en: I’ve heard they migrate as far up as Route 4, though!
ja: でも、4番道路まで移動することもあるって聞きます!

key: The flowers on its antlers smell so sweet-- just like the cherry blossoms they resemble........
en: The flowers on its antlers smell so sweet-- just like the cherry blossoms they resemble........
ja: 角についた花が、とても甘く香ります――見た目通り、まるで桜のように……

key: This one has so many of them........
en: This one has so many of them........
ja: この子は、こんなにたくさんつけてるんですね……

key: I’ve heard that Sawsbuck with more flowers tend to grow at a slower pace.
en: I’ve heard that Sawsbuck with more flowers tend to grow at a slower pace.
ja: 花が多いメブキジカほど、成長がゆっくりだって聞きます。

key: While such a journey may take a little bit of patience........
en: While such a journey may take a little bit of patience........
ja: そういう道のりには、少し忍耐が必要かもしれませんけど……

key: I'd like to think the time it takes is worth the beauty at the end, even to the Pokémon.
en: I'd like to think the time it takes is worth the beauty at the end, even to the Pokémon.
ja: その分だけ、最後に手に入る美しさには、きっと価値があると思いたいです。ポケモンにとっても、それは同じでしょうね。

key: LAURA: A Wormadam........ They’re quite underappreciated, I think.
en: LAURA: A Wormadam........ They’re quite underappreciated, I think.
ja: ローラ: ミノマダムですか……あまり評価されていない子だと思います。

key: Somewhat sweet-smelling........ like freshly grown grass.
en: Somewhat sweet-smelling........ like freshly grown grass.
ja: 少し甘い香りがしますね……刈りたての新しい草のような。

key: They’re adaptable, willing to change and grow-- to blossom with its surroundings.
en: They’re adaptable, willing to change and grow-- to blossom with its surroundings.
ja: 適応力があって、変化して成長することをいとわない子です――周りの環境とともに花開くんですね。

key: I hope that tendency to change comes from the joy of trying something new rather than fear and pressure to adapt.
en: I hope that tendency to change comes from the joy of trying something new rather than fear and pressure to adapt.
ja: その変化への傾向が、適応への恐れやプレッシャーからではなく、新しいことに挑む喜びから来ているといいんですけど。

key: ........If you do have to change before I'm done with my sample, leave your old coat where I can find it, okay?
en: ........If you do have to change before I'm done with my sample, leave your old coat where I can find it, okay?
ja: ……もしサンプルが終わる前に変化することになったら、脱いだ殻は見つけやすいところに置いておいてくださいね?

key: LAURA: Oh! A Lilligant! I have one of my own, did you know?
en: LAURA: Oh! A Lilligant! I have one of my own, did you know?
ja: ローラ: あら! ドレディア! わたしも一匹飼っているんです、ご存じでしたか?

key: Of course, I've already sampled mine for the mix, but let me visit at yours still!
en: Of course, I've already sampled mine for the mix, but let me visit at yours still!
ja: もちろん、うちの子の香りはもう調合に使わせてもらいましたけど、あなたの子のところにもお邪魔させてくださいね!

key: As two people can smell different, so can two Lilligant.
en: As two people can smell different, so can two Lilligant.
ja: 人が二人いれば匂いが違うように、ドレディアも一匹一匹違うものです。

key: And in my opinion, they really are the crème de la crème of head notes.
en: And in my opinion, they really are the crème de la crème of head notes.
ja: わたしの意見では、この子たちこそ、まさにヘッドノートの中のヘッドノートです。

key: The saffron of soliflores!
en: The saffron of soliflores!
ja: ソリフロールの中のサフランですね!

key: I would love to hear the story of how you and your Lilligant bonded.
en: I would love to hear the story of how you and your Lilligant bonded.
ja: あなたとドレディアのきずなの物語、ぜひ聞かせていただきたいです。

key: They're notoriously difficult to care for, after all, but yours appears to be in full bloom.
en: They're notoriously difficult to care for, after all, but yours appears to be in full bloom.
ja: この子たちの世話が難しいことで有名ですけど、あなたのこの子は、見事に満開ですね。

key: I met mine as a Petilil, back at my family's old house, but I didn't call her mine until after she evolved.
en: I met mine as a Petilil, back at my family's old house, but I didn't call her mine until after she evolved.
ja: うちの子とは、実家にいた頃、チュリネの時に出会いました。でも、進化するまでは、自分の子だとは呼べませんでした。

key: She was so shy!
en: She was so shy!
ja: とても恥ずかしがり屋だったんです!

key: She showed me where best to start my garden.
en: She showed me where best to start my garden.
ja: 庭をどこから始めるのが一番いいか、教えてくれました。

key: Oh, how it grew!
en: Oh, how it grew!
ja: ああ、あんなに育って!

key: But I didn't see her again for a long time after that.
en: But I didn't see her again for a long time after that.
ja: でも、それから長い間、彼女には会えませんでした。

key: Not until I was sick for longer than usual-- it wasn't that unusual-- and I was certain the plants wouldn't last.
en: Not until I was sick for longer than usual-- it wasn't that unusual-- and I was certain the plants wouldn't last.
ja: いつもより長く体調を崩して――と言っても、それ自体は珍しいことじゃなかったんですけど――植物たちがもう持たないだろうと確信していた頃まで、会えなかったんです。

key: I tried to tell Saphira what to do........ but she could kill even a plastic houseplant.
en: I tried to tell Saphira what to do........ but she could kill even a plastic houseplant.
ja: サファイラに、何をすればいいか伝えようとしたんですけど……あの子ときたら、造花すら枯らしかねない子で。

key: They were doomed, I was sure........
en: They were doomed, I was sure........
ja: もう駄目だと、確信していました……

key: ........Until I heaved myself over the windowsill from my room on the second floor--
en: ........Until I heaved myself over the windowsill from my room on the second floor--
ja: ……でも、2階の自分の部屋の窓枠から、身を乗り出した時――

key: It was right on the back corner, a perfect view of the plot--
en: It was right on the back corner, a perfect view of the plot--
ja: ちょうど裏の隅にあって、花壇がよく見える場所で――

key: And saw Lilligant tending to the garden.
en: And saw Lilligant tending to the garden.
ja: ドレディアが庭の世話をしているのが、見えたんです。

key: Her flower wasn't in bloom yet, but I knew what I saw.
en: Her flower wasn't in bloom yet, but I knew what I saw.
ja: その花はまだ咲いていませんでしたけど、自分の見たものは分かっていました。

key: I fell down in shock, and Mom must've heard the thud my rump made.
en: I fell down in shock, and Mom must've heard the thud my rump made.
ja: 驚いて尻もちをついてしまって、その音でお母さんが気づいたんだと思います。

key: She came rushing up at once, and I cried and demanded she take me outside........
en: She came rushing up at once, and I cried and demanded she take me outside........
ja: すぐに駆けつけてきてくれて、わたしは泣きながら外に連れて行ってと訴えました……

key: Lilligant was gone by the time we got out there, of course.
en: Lilligant was gone by the time we got out there, of course.
ja: もちろん、外に出た頃には、ドレディアの姿はもうありませんでした。

key: Mom said "Come in," and I said "No," and clung to the fencepost for dear life.
en: Mom said "Come in," and I said "No," and clung to the fencepost for dear life.
ja: お母さんは「中に入りなさい」と言って、わたしは「嫌」と言って、必死に柵の柱にしがみつきました。

key: "There was no Lilligant," they told me. "You're seeing things."
en: "There was no Lilligant," they told me. "You're seeing things."
ja: 「ドレディアなんていなかったのよ」って言われました。「幻を見たんでしょう」って。

key: But I planted my roots.
en: But I planted my roots.
ja: でも、わたしは根を張って動きませんでした。

key: Eventually Charlotte cried louder than me-- she was still tiny at the time-- and I was permitted to my temper tantrum.
en: Eventually Charlotte cried louder than me-- she was still tiny at the time-- and I was permitted to my temper tantrum.
ja: そのうち、シャルロットがわたしよりも大声で泣き出して――あの頃はまだ小さかったので――結局わたしのかんしゃくは大目に見てもらえました。

key: Saphira snuck me cookies and a coat.
en: Saphira snuck me cookies and a coat.
ja: サファイラが、こっそりクッキーと上着を持ってきてくれました。

key: We tried to make a tent out of it but it wasn't any good.
en: We tried to make a tent out of it but it wasn't any good.
ja: それでテントを作ろうとしたんですけど、うまくいきませんでした。

key: We slept outside that night and she made sure no prying parents took me from my post when I got too sleepy to protest.
en: We slept outside that night and she made sure no prying parents took me from my post when I got too sleepy to protest.
ja: その夜は外で眠って、わたしが眠くて抗議できなくなった時も、詮索好きな両親に持ち場から連れ戻されないよう、あの子が見張っててくれました。

key: I woke up to the sunrise, still sick and half-delirious,
en: I woke up to the sunrise, still sick and half-delirious,
ja: 目が覚めると朝日が昇っていて、まだ具合が悪く、半分うわごとみたいな状態でしたけど、

key: But Lilligant was there too.
en: But Lilligant was there too.
ja: そこには、ドレディアもいたんです。

key: Saphira was-- I believe the word Dad used was "zonked" out.
en: Saphira was-- I believe the word Dad used was "zonked" out.
ja: サファイラは――お父さんの言葉を借りるなら「ぶっ倒れて」いました。

key: She slept face down in fertilizer.
en: She slept face down in fertilizer.
ja: 肥料の上に、うつぶせで眠っていたんです。

key: Lilligant and I worked on the garden until we heard Mom stir.
en: Lilligant and I worked on the garden until we heard Mom stir.
ja: お母さんが起き出す音が聞こえるまで、ドレディアとわたしは庭の世話を続けました。

key: She tried to slip away, and I begged her to stay.
en: She tried to slip away, and I begged her to stay.
ja: こっそり立ち去ろうとするので、いてほしいと頼みました。

key: Truthfully, I think she didn't have the heart to tell my kid self "No".
en: Truthfully, I think she didn't have the heart to tell my kid self "No".
ja: 正直、あの頃の子どもだったわたしに「駄目」と言う気には、なれなかったんだと思います。

key: Could you?
en: Could you?
ja: あなたなら、言えましたか?

key: But she was seen in her moment of indecision. So the choice was made for her.
en: But she was seen in her moment of indecision. So the choice was made for her.
ja: でも、迷っているところを見られてしまって。だから、選択はあの子の代わりに決まってしまいました。

key: She and Saphira teamed up after that.
en: She and Saphira teamed up after that.
ja: それ以来、あの子とサファイラは、コンビを組むようになりました。

key: My Dad said he had hayfever, but I think what he was really allergic to was their fiery spirit.
en: My Dad said he had hayfever, but I think what he was really allergic to was their fiery spirit.
ja: お父さんは花粉症だって言ってましたけど、本当にアレルギーだったのは、二人の熱い気性のほうだったと思います。

key: Sick or not, I wanted to work in the garden, and so they made it happen.
en: Sick or not, I wanted to work in the garden, and so they made it happen.
ja: 具合が悪くても、庭仕事がしたかったわたしのために、二人はそれをかなえてくれました。

key: Little by little, it all got better.
en: Little by little, it all got better.
ja: 少しずつ、すべてが良くなっていきました。

key: The garden, my health, and her flower........
en: The garden, my health, and her flower........
ja: 庭も、わたしの体調も、あの子の花も……

key: By the time one blossomed, they all did.
en: By the time one blossomed, they all did.
ja: ひとつが花開く頃には、すべてが花開いていました。

key: There was never any going back from there.
en: There was never any going back from there.
ja: そこからは、もう後戻りすることはありませんでした。

key: Even as a kid, I knew that.
en: Even as a kid, I knew that.
ja: 子どもだったわたしにも、それは分かっていました。

key: It's the same for you, isn't it?
en: It's the same for you, isn't it?
ja: あなたも、同じなんじゃないですか?

key: She joined you because she wants to fight. She wanted to help you.
en: She joined you because she wants to fight. She wanted to help you.
ja: この子があなたの仲間になったのは、戦いたいからです。あなたを助けたかったんです。

key: See her through to the end, won't you?
en: See her through to the end, won't you?
ja: 最後まで、見届けてあげてくださいね?

key: It's difficult to care for them as a busy Trainer though, isn't it?
en: It's difficult to care for them as a busy Trainer though, isn't it?
ja: 忙しいトレーナーとして世話をするのは、難しいですよね?

key: This one is telling me that she'd love to spend more time at your side.
en: This one is telling me that she'd love to spend more time at your side.
ja: この子は、もっとあなたのそばで過ごしたいって、わたしに伝えてくれています。

key: She wants to earn her sunlight.
en: She wants to earn her sunlight.
ja: 自分の日光を、勝ち取りたいんです。

key: She wants to earn your trust,
en: She wants to earn your trust,
ja: あなたの信頼を、勝ち取りたいんです。

key: But she needs a little more support to make it there.
en: But she needs a little more support to make it there.
ja: でも、そこにたどり着くには、もう少し支えが必要なんです。

key: Don't let her waste away in a PC Box, okay?
en: Don't let her waste away in a PC Box, okay?
ja: ボックスの中で、無駄に過ごさせないであげてくださいね?

key: The PCs-- they do everything they can to keep the Pokémon comfortable.
en: The PCs-- they do everything they can to keep the Pokémon comfortable.
ja: パソコンは――ポケモンが快適に過ごせるよう、できることは何でもしてくれます。

key: I know this because I've worried about and researched it extensively.
en: I know this because I've worried about and researched it extensively.
ja: それは、わたしがずっと心配して、たくさん調べてきたから知っているんです。

key: But she joined you because she wants to fight. She wanted to help you.
en: But she joined you because she wants to fight. She wanted to help you.
ja: でも、この子があなたの仲間になったのは、戦いたいからです。あなたを助けたかったんです。

key: She'll bloom best at your side.
en: She'll bloom best at your side.
ja: あなたのそばでこそ、この子は一番美しく咲くでしょう。

key: LAURA: Oh, this is that rare Lilligant form from Sinnoh!
en: LAURA: Oh, this is that rare Lilligant form from Sinnoh!
ja: ローラ: あら、これはシンオウ地方の珍しいドレディアの姿ですね!

key: I have a Lilligant myself, that I already added to the mix, but this form is different enough-- to say nothing of each individual Lilligant’s differences.
en: I have a Lilligant myself, that I already added to the mix, but this form is different enough-- to say nothing of each individual Lilligant’s differences.
ja: わたしもドレディアを飼っていて、もう調合に加えたんですけど、この姿は十分に違いますね――一匹一匹の個体差は言うまでもなく。

key: Hisuian Lilligant, like this, have a scent that’s supposed to be more energizing compared to their more widespread counterpart.
en: Hisuian Lilligant, like this, have a scent that’s supposed to be more energizing compared to their more widespread counterpart.
ja: こういうヒスイのドレディアは、もっと一般的な姿の子に比べて、活力を与えるような香りがするそうです。

key: It's wonderful in its own way!
en: It's wonderful in its own way!
ja: それはそれで、素敵ですね!

key: Isn’t it odd how regional variants can exist here in Reborn?
en: Isn’t it odd how regional variants can exist here in Reborn?
ja: リボーンで、地域による姿の違いが存在するなんて、不思議だと思いませんか?

key: I'm not sure if you got your Lilligant here-- you simply must tell me where if so--
en: I'm not sure if you got your Lilligant here-- you simply must tell me where if so--
ja: このドレディアをここで手に入れたのかは分かりませんけど――もしそうなら、ぜひどこでか教えてください――

key: But other regional variants, like Alolan Exeggutor from Tourmaline Desert, are also wild in Reborn.
en: But other regional variants, like Alolan Exeggutor from Tourmaline Desert, are also wild in Reborn.
ja: でも、トルマリン砂漠のアローラのナッシーみたいに、他の地域の姿の子も、リボーンには野生でいますよね。

key: Some environments are close enough to their home region, I suppose?
en: Some environments are close enough to their home region, I suppose?
ja: きっと、環境が故郷の地方に近いところがあるんでしょうね?

key: But why would that only be the case in Reborn?
en: But why would that only be the case in Reborn?
ja: でも、それがリボーンだけで起こるのは、なぜなんでしょう?

key: LAURA: I’ll have to be careful with this one........
en: LAURA: I’ll have to be careful with this one........
ja: ローラ: この子には、気をつけないといけませんね……

key: Are you sure your Meowscarada is okay with this?
en: Are you sure your Meowscarada is okay with this?
ja: 本当に、あなたのマスカーニャは、これで大丈夫なんですか?

key: It’s such a proud Pokémon, and I certainly don’t want to make its flower burst!
en: It’s such a proud Pokémon, and I certainly don’t want to make its flower burst!
ja: とても誇り高いポケモンですし、その花を無理に開かせてしまうようなことは、絶対にしたくありません!

key: Meowscarada perfume is a rarity precisely for that reason.
en: Meowscarada perfume is a rarity precisely for that reason.
ja: だからこそ、マスカーニャの香水は、とても貴重なものなんです。

key: I’ve heard it smells like pomegranate........
en: I’ve heard it smells like pomegranate........
ja: ザクロのような香りがするって聞きます……

key: Isn't that a forbidden flavor in some stories?
en: Isn't that a forbidden flavor in some stories?
ja: 物語の中では、禁断の味とされていたりしませんか?

key: I can't help but be nervous what might happen to me if I sample it........
en: I can't help but be nervous what might happen to me if I sample it........
ja: サンプルを取ったら自分に何が起きるのか、どうしても不安になってしまいます……

key: LAURA: A Glimmora? But that's not even........
en: LAURA: A Glimmora? But that's not even........
ja: ローラ: キラフロル? でも、それってそもそも……

key: Did-- Did you expect me to take powder from poisonous stone?
en: Did-- Did you expect me to take powder from poisonous stone?
ja: 毒のある石から、粉を採るつもりだったんですか?

key: Is this a prank? Or a challenge?
en: Is this a prank? Or a challenge?
ja: これは、いたずらですか? それとも挑戦?

key: But then, sometimes the only difference between medicine and poison is the dosage.
en: But then, sometimes the only difference between medicine and poison is the dosage.
ja: でも、薬と毒の違いなんて、時には量だけということもありますよね。

key: Glimmora are similar to Tera Jewels, aren't they?
en: Glimmora are similar to Tera Jewels, aren't they?
ja: キラフロルって、テラジェムに似てますよね?

key: Those are a potent attractant........ possibly even as crystalline dust........
en: Those are a potent attractant........ possibly even as crystalline dust........
ja: あれは強力な誘引物質です……結晶の粉末になったとしても、きっと。

key: Okay, I think I can do this.
en: Okay, I think I can do this.
ja: よし、これならできそうです。

key: Still, I'd better dilute it plenty extra to be safe...
en: Still, I'd better dilute it plenty extra to be safe...
ja: とはいえ、念のため、たっぷり薄めておいたほうが良さそうですね……

key: LAURA: Oh, is this........ an Ogerpon?
en: LAURA: Oh, is this........ an Ogerpon?
ja: ローラ: あら、これは……オーガポン、ですか?

key: Wherever did you find one?
en: Wherever did you find one?
ja: いったい、どこで見つけたんですか?

key: I’ve never seen a real one before, only in paintings and stories........
en: I’ve never seen a real one before, only in paintings and stories........
ja: 本物を見たのは初めてです、絵画や物語の中でしか見たことがなくて……

key: But there is a flower, isn’t there? I should be able to use it.
en: But there is a flower, isn’t there? I should be able to use it.
ja: でも、花はちゃんとありますね? これなら使えそうです。

key: It smells an awful lot like peaches, doesn’t it?
en: It smells an awful lot like peaches, doesn’t it?
ja: 桃のような香りが、とても強くしますね?

key: But there’s a distinct note of morning dew to it, too........
en: But there’s a distinct note of morning dew to it, too........
ja: でも、朝露のような香りも、はっきりと感じられます……

key: Its mask is sad, but its face is so cute.
en: Its mask is sad, but its face is so cute.
ja: 面は悲しげですけど、顔はとてもかわいいですね。

key: But there’s a distinct smoky note to it, too........
en: But there’s a distinct smoky note to it, too........
ja: でも、くすぶしたような香りも、はっきりと感じられます……

key: Its mask is fierce, but its face is so cute.
en: Its mask is fierce, but its face is so cute.
ja: 面は猛々しいですけど、顔はとてもかわいいですね。

key: But there’s a distinct earthy note to it, too........
en: But there’s a distinct earthy note to it, too........
ja: でも、土のような香りも、はっきりと感じられます……

key: Its mask is tough, but its face is so cute.
en: Its mask is tough, but its face is so cute.
ja: 面はいかついですけど、顔はとてもかわいいですね。

key: But there’s a distinct floral note to it, too........
en: But there’s a distinct floral note to it, too........
ja: でも、花のような香りも、はっきりと感じられます……

key: Its mask is sharp, but its face is so cute.
en: Its mask is sharp, but its face is so cute.
ja: 面は鋭いですけど、顔はとてもかわいいですね。

key: I hope this one hasn't been through so much that it feels like it always has to hide from others.
en: I hope this one hasn't been through so much that it feels like it always has to hide from others.
ja: この子が、いつも他の子から隠れなければと感じるほど、大変な思いをしていなければいいんですけど。

key: LAURA: Oh, hello, little one!
en: LAURA: Oh, hello, little one!
ja: ローラ: あら、こんにちは、あなた!

key: \PN, did you know? They might not quite look the type, but Cacnea have a yellow flower blooming atop their heads for all to see.
en: \PN, did you know? They might not quite look the type, but Cacnea have a yellow flower blooming atop their heads for all to see.
ja: \PN、ご存じでしたか? そうは見えないかもしれませんが、サボネアは頭の上に、誰にでも見える黄色い花を咲かせているんです。

key: I used to think it was a crown as a kid-- my sisters and I had seen one resting atop one of our flowerpots once before.
en: I used to think it was a crown as a kid-- my sisters and I had seen one resting atop one of our flowerpots once before.
ja: 子どもの頃は、それを王冠だと思ってました――姉妹みんなで、うちの植木鉢の上に乗っているのを見たことがあって。

key: Charlotte had tried to take its crown for herself, a silly joke-- but no!
en: Charlotte had tried to take its crown for herself, a silly joke-- but no!
ja: シャルロットが、ふざけてその王冠を自分のものにしようとしたんですけど――駄目でした!

key: Cacnea so rarely bloom, though-- it's a treat to see a full flower.
en: Cacnea so rarely bloom, though-- it's a treat to see a full flower.
ja: サボネアが花を咲かせることは滅多にないので――満開の花を見られるのは、貴重なご褒美です。

key: Their flowers smell of fresh rainfall-- perhaps the water they store in their bodies has something to do with it.
en: Their flowers smell of fresh rainfall-- perhaps the water they store in their bodies has something to do with it.
ja: 花は、降ったばかりの雨のような香りがします――体に蓄えている水と、何か関係があるのかもしれません。

key: It seems quite a pleasant head note, don't you think?
en: It seems quite a pleasant head note, don't you think?
ja: とても心地良いヘッドノートになりそうだと思いませんか?

key: LAURA: Oh, I hope this little one isn't too much trouble for you!
en: LAURA: Oh, I hope this little one isn't too much trouble for you!
ja: ローラ: あら、この子があなたを困らせすぎていなければいいんですけど!

key: I've heard Capsakid can be quite the little troublemakers.
en: I've heard Capsakid can be quite the little troublemakers.
ja: カプサイジは、けっこうな問題児になることがあるって聞きます。

key: I know many raise them for their teeth, but their flowers are certainly useful in perfume, too-- no other Pokémon smells quite as spicy.
en: I know many raise them for their teeth, but their flowers are certainly useful in perfume, too-- no other Pokémon smells quite as spicy.
ja: その歯のために育てる人が多いのは知っていますけど、花も香水にはとても役立つんです――他のどのポケモンも、こんなにスパイシーな香りはしません。

key: It'll definitely work wonders here!
en: It'll definitely work wonders here!
ja: きっと、ここでも素晴らしい効果を発揮しますよ!

key: LAURA: Oh, you have a good eye, \PN!
en: LAURA: Oh, you have a good eye, \PN!
ja: ローラ: あら、\PN、あなたは目が良いですね!

key: Trainers who have never trained Lurantis almost never realize that it itself is a flower, just reshaped and disguised.
en: Trainers who have never trained Lurantis almost never realize that it itself is a flower, just reshaped and disguised.
ja: ラランテスを育てたことのないトレーナーは、あの姿自体が、形を変え姿を隠した花そのものだと、ほとんど気づかないものです。

key: They're lovely, yes, but to be considered the best at something they're actively trying to hide? It must be awfully upsetting........
en: They're lovely, yes, but to be considered the best at something they're actively trying to hide? It must be awfully upsetting........
ja: とても素敵な子たちですけど、自分が必死に隠しているものについて一番だと言われるなんて、きっとひどくつらいことでしょうね……

key: That'll be it! I've gotten enough powder to finish the scent set.
en: That'll be it! I've gotten enough powder to finish the scent set.
ja: これで終わりです! 香りのセットを仕上げるのに、十分な粉が集まりました。

key: Give me just a moment to add the finishing touches........
en: Give me just a moment to add the finishing touches........
ja: 少しだけ時間をください、仕上げの作業をしますので……

key: LAURA: And voilà! An extravagant eight palette perfume, perfect for any purpose~
en: LAURA: And voilà! An extravagant eight palette perfume, perfect for any purpose~
ja: ローラ: さあ、できました! どんな目的にもぴったりの、ぜいたくな8色パレットの香水です~

key: LAURA: And one for Saphira as well.
en: LAURA: And one for Saphira as well.
ja: ローラ: それから、サファイラの分もひとつ。

key: Thanks for helping me see this little project to fruition!
en: Thanks for helping me see this little project to fruition!
ja: この小さな計画を実らせる手伝いをしてくれて、ありがとうございました!

key: You really didn't have to do all that for a stranger.
en: You really didn't have to do all that for a stranger.
ja: 見ず知らずの相手のために、そこまでしてくれる必要はなかったのに。

key: I have one more gift as thanks, if you'd be interested.
en: I have one more gift as thanks, if you'd be interested.
ja: よろしければ、お礼にもうひとつ贈り物があります。

key: A little Petilil-- young and eager to explore the world. Would you care to take her along?
en: A little Petilil-- young and eager to explore the world.  Would you care to take her along?
ja: 小さなチュリネです――若くて、世界を探検したくてたまらないんです。連れて行ってあげてもらえませんか?

key: LAURA: I know you'll take good care of her for me.
en: LAURA: I know you'll take good care of her for me.
ja: ローラ: わたしの代わりに、大切にしてくれると信じています。

key: LAURA: I understand! They aren't for everyone, after all.
en: LAURA: I understand! They aren't for everyone, after all.
ja: ローラ: 分かりました! こういうのは、誰にでも合うものではありませんもんね。

key: Nevertheless, I'd best be along now, lest Saphira fear I've been apprehended again and find some handle to fly off of.
en: Nevertheless, I'd best be along now, lest Saphira fear I've been apprehended again and find some handle to fly off of.
ja: とはいえ、そろそろ行かなくてはいけません。またわたしが捕まったんじゃないかとサファイラが心配して、飛んで行く先を探し出したりしたら大変ですから。

key: I'll be heading east to the Chrysolia region. Do you know it?
en: I'll be heading east to the Chrysolia region. Do you know it?
ja: 東のクリソリア地方に向かいます。ご存じですか?

key: Our family has a cabin hidden there.
en: Our family has a cabin hidden there.
ja: うちの家族が、そこに隠れ家の小屋を持っているんです。

key: My sister's written to me all about her having it rebuilt. I'm so excited to see it again!
en: My sister's written to me all about her having it rebuilt.  I'm so excited to see it again!
ja: 姉が、その小屋を建て直したことを手紙で知らせてくれました。また見られると思うと、とても楽しみです!

key: If you're ever in the area, I'd love for you to visit.
en: If you're ever in the area, I'd love for you to visit.
ja: もしその辺りに来ることがあったら、ぜひ訪ねてきてくださいね。

key: Take care, \PN.
en: Take care, \PN.
ja: お元気で、\PN。

key: May your own adventure be made all the more comfortable by the rainbow array.
en: May your own adventure be made all the more comfortable by the rainbow array.
ja: この虹色の香りが、あなたの冒険を、もっと心地良いものにしてくれますように。

key: LAURA: One down, two to go. I'll keep working here, if that's okay.
en: LAURA: One down, two to go. I'll keep working here, if that's okay.
ja: ローラ: これでひとつ。あと二つ残っています。良ければ、ここで作業を続けさせてくださいね。

key: It may just be a modest park........
en: It may just be a modest park........
ja: ここはただの、ささやかな公園かもしれませんけど……

key: And the soil may be bereft of either nutrients or depth........
en: And the soil may be bereft of either nutrients or depth........
ja: 土には、栄養も深さも足りていないかもしれませんけど……

key: ........And it may be in dire need of water either clean or plenty........
en: ........And it may be in dire need of water either clean or plenty........
ja: ……それに、きれいな水も、たっぷりの水も、切実に必要としているのかもしれませんけど……

key: ........But all the same, it needs someone to enjoy it, don't you think?
en: ........But all the same, it needs someone to enjoy it, don't you think?
ja: ……それでも、誰かに楽しんでもらうことが必要だと思うんです。

key: And it's been far too long since I had the luxury of enjoying the outdoors.
en: And it's been far too long since I had the luxury of enjoying the outdoors.
ja: それに、外の空気をゆっくり楽しむぜいたくからも、ずいぶんと遠ざかっていましたから。

key: LAURA: Just one more now. We're close.
en: LAURA: Just one more now. We're close.
ja: ローラ: あとひとつです。もう少しですね。

key: I'll be leaving the city after this.
en: I'll be leaving the city after this.
ja: これが終わったら、この街を出ます。

key: To be honest, I hadn't meant to stay here even this long, but I was struck by the impulse and had to follow through.
en: To be honest, I hadn't meant to stay here even this long, but I was struck by the impulse and had to follow through.
ja: 正直に言うと、こんなに長く留まるつもりはなかったんですけど、衝動に駆られて、最後までやり通さずにはいられませんでした。

key: At first, I just wanted to make a perfume to mask the urban musk as I made my journey home, but then I got to thinking........
en: At first, I just wanted to make a perfume to mask the urban musk as I made my journey home, but then I got to thinking........
ja: 最初は、帰り道の間、都会のむっとした匂いを隠すための香水を作りたかっただけなんです。でも、そのうちに考え始めてしまって……

key: I have a sister, did you know? Two, actually.
en: I have a sister, did you know? Two, actually.
ja: わたしには姉妹がいるんです、ご存じでしたか? 実は、二人。

key: One has been waiting patiently........ or, perhaps, impatiently, for me to return home for a long time now.
en: One has been waiting patiently........ or, perhaps, impatiently, for me to return home for a long time now.
ja: 一人は、ずっと辛抱強く……いえ、もしかしたら、じれったそうに、わたしが帰るのを待っていてくれています。

key: So I thought, perhaps I could celebrate my homecoming with a gift to her.
en: So I thought, perhaps I could celebrate my homecoming with a gift to her.
ja: それで、帰った時にはあの子への贈り物で、帰郷を祝えたらいいなと思ったんです。

key: She might chide me for giving her a gift so soon after my own birthday........
en: She might chide me for giving her a gift so soon after my own birthday........
ja: 自分の誕生日のすぐあとに贈り物なんてって、たしなめられるかもしれませんけど……

key: But it's my life to celebrate, and I'd rather do so by giving something to those who've cared for me, rather than taking it.
en: But it's my life to celebrate, and I'd rather do so by giving something to those who've cared for me, rather than taking it.
ja: でも、これはわたしの人生を祝うことですし、何かをもらうよりも、大切にしてくれた人たちに贈るほうが、わたしらしいと思うんです。

key: Thank you, \PN, for being part of that celebration~
en: Thank you, \PN, for being part of that celebration~
ja: ありがとう、\PN。この祝い事の一部になってくれて~

key: Obsidia's Main Street really isn't the same with a giant crack running through it.
en: Obsidia's Main Street really isn't the same with a giant crack running through it.
ja: 巨大な亀裂が走ってると、オブシディアのメインストリートも本当に別物だな。

key: Proceed with caution.
en: Proceed with caution.
ja: 十分注意して進んでください。

key: It's as if the plants themselves are rising up to strike back at humans.
en: It's as if the plants themselves are rising up to strike back at humans.
ja: まるで植物たちが自ら立ち上がって、人間に反撃しているみたいだ。

key: We deserve no less after what we've done.
en: We deserve no less after what we've done.
ja: 俺たちがやってきたことを思えば、当然の報いかもな。

key: The Day-Care Couple wouldn't give me my Pokémon back!
en: The Day-Care Couple wouldn't give me my Pokémon back!
ja: 育て屋の夫婦が、ポケモンを返してくれないの!

key: They just keep telling me that the Pokémon aren't feeling well and to try back next week! What a mess!
en: They just keep telling me that the Pokémon aren't feeling well and to try back next week! What a mess!
ja: ポケモンの具合が悪いから来週また来てって、ずっと言われてて! もう最悪!

key: Ugh! These vines are so annoying!
en: Ugh! These vines are so annoying!
ja: もう! このツタ、邪魔すぎる!

key: Go away already! I have to get home!
en: Go away already! I have to get home!
ja: 早くどっか行ってよ! 家に帰らないといけないのに!

key: Silph Co. has really bursted into business lately. Have you SEEN the stuff at the top of the Department Store?!
en: Silph Co. has really bursted into business lately. Have you SEEN the stuff at the top of the Department Store?!
ja: シルフ社、最近すごい勢いだよね。デパートの上の階、見た?!

key: Stay tuned for Silph Co.'s latest innovation, the Link Stone!
en: Stay tuned for Silph Co.'s latest innovation, the Link Stone!
ja: シルフ社の最新技術、リンクストーンにご期待ください!

key: With the Link Stone, you can evolve Pokémon you would normally need to trade away to evolve!
en: With the Link Stone, you can evolve Pokémon you would normally need to trade away to evolve!
ja: リンクストーンがあれば、通常は交換が必要な進化も、可能になります!

key: In stores soon!
en: In stores soon!
ja: 近日発売!

key: <- Saffron Street\n^v - 11th Street
en: <- Saffron Street\n^v - 11th Street
ja: <- サフラン通り\n^v - 11番通り

key: Midterms are the most evil thing ever! Ugh!
en: Midterms are the most evil thing ever! Ugh!
ja: 中間試験なんて、この世で一番の悪だよ! もう!

key: Man, I really wanna get up to the upper levels of the Department Store, but they only allow members access.
en: Man, I really wanna get up to the upper levels of the Department Store, but they only allow members access.
ja: あーあ、デパートの上の階に行きたいのに、会員しか入れないんだよな。

key: My home has been ruined by the plants. What must I do?
en: My home has been ruined by the plants. What must I do?
ja: 植物のせいで家がめちゃくちゃになっちまった。どうしたらいいんだ?

key: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this foul storm?
en: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this foul storm?
ja: 家を失って、このひどい嵐の中、行くあてもない年寄りに、小銭を恵んでもらえないか?

key: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this miserable heat?
en: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to go in this miserable heat?
ja: 家を失って、この惨めな暑さの中、行くあてもない年寄りに、小銭を恵んでもらえないか?

key: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to take shelter?
en: Change for an old man who's lost his home, and has nowhere to take shelter?
ja: 家を失って、雨風をしのぐ場所もない年寄りに、小銭を恵んでもらえないか?

key: Please observe caution while traversing the area.
en: Please observe caution while traversing the area.
ja: この区域を通行する際は、十分注意してください。

key: Everything is going to be okay.
en: Everything is going to be okay.
ja: すべて大丈夫だから。

key: There is no need to panic,
en: There is no need to panic,
ja: パニックになる必要はない、

key: Probably.
en: Probably.
ja: たぶんな。

key: How am I supposed to get back to the Onyx Ward now?
en: How am I supposed to get back to the Onyx Ward now?
ja: これじゃ、オニキス区にどうやって戻ればいいんだよ?

key: Stunkin' plants, futzin' up our sidewalkers! Imma tear 'em a new one!
en: Stunkin' plants, futzin' up our sidewalkers! Imma tear 'em a new one!
ja: くっせえ植物どもが、歩道をめちゃくちゃにしやがって! 引きちぎってやる!

key: ...Er, a first one!
en: ...Er, a first one!
ja: ……いや、そもそも初めてか!

key: <- Main Street\n^v - 11th Street
en: <- Main Street\n^v - 11th Street
ja: <- メインストリート\n^v - 11番通り

key: It's such a nice park when it's not threatening to destroy the city.
en: It's such a nice park when it's not threatening to destroy the city.
ja: 街を破壊しそうになってなければ、いい公園なんだけどな。

key: FLORINIA: Report.
en: FLORINIA: Report.
ja: フロリニア: 報告を。

key: AMARIA: No luck on finding Borealis, unfortunately.
en: AMARIA: No luck on finding Borealis, unfortunately.
ja: アマリア: 残念ながら、ボレアリスは見つからなかった。

key: Someone with his description was definitely seen entering the slums, but I couldn't find anything from there.
en: Someone with his description was definitely seen entering the slums, but I couldn't find anything from there.
ja: 特徴が一致する人物がスラムに入るのを目撃されてたけど、そこから先は何も分からなかった。

key: I even checked as far as Coral, but nothing.
en: I even checked as far as Coral, but nothing.
ja: コーラル区まで足を伸ばして確認したけど、何もなし。

key: If he was in the area, I think it's too late by now.
en: If he was in the area, I think it's too late by now.
ja: もしあの辺りにいたとしても、もう手遅れだと思う。

key: FLORINIA: Understood.
en: FLORINIA: Understood.
ja: フロリニア: 了解した。

key: As presented, the most efficient course of investigation remains a direct exploration of the affected area.
en: As presented, the most efficient course of investigation remains a direct exploration of the affected area.
ja: 現状を鑑みるに、最も効率的な調査方法は、依然として被害区域への直接的な踏み込みである。

key: With the given four parties present, safety should be adequately accounted for.
en: With the given four parties present, safety should be adequately accounted for.
ja: 現在の4名の陣容であれば、安全性は十分に確保できるはずだ。

key: AMARIA: Basically we charge right in and see what's up!
en: AMARIA: Basically we charge right in and see what's up!
ja: アマリア: つまり、まっすぐ突っ込んで、様子を見ようってこと!

key: I'm all for it.
en: I'm all for it.
ja: あたしは大賛成。

key: On your call, Rini!
en: On your call, Rini!
ja: あんたの号令待ちだよ、リニ!

key: AMARIA: We should be ready for anything in there!
en: AMARIA: We should be ready for anything in there!
ja: アマリア: 中では何が起きても、対応できるようにしとかないとね!

key: Personally, I'm pulling for the plants.
en: Personally, I'm pulling for the plants.
ja: 個人的には、植物を応援してるけど。

key: Grow babies, grow!
en: Grow babies, grow!
ja: 育て育て、たくさん育て!

key: As fascinating as this is, I can't help but stand frozen in fear...
en: As fascinating as this is, I can't help but stand frozen in fear...
ja: 興味深いとは思うんだけど、恐怖で体が固まっちゃって動けない……

key: I simply must find some remnant of those vines to study their biochemistry.
en: I simply must find some remnant of those vines to study their biochemistry.
ja: あのツタの残骸を何としても見つけて、生化学的に調べなければ。

key: "Sweet Kiss"\nReborn's One-Stop Candy Shop!
en: "Sweet Kiss"\nReborn's One-Stop Candy Shop!
ja: 「スイートキス」\nリボーンのお菓子なら何でもそろう店!

key: How does a stupid plant do all this?!
en: How does a stupid plant do all this?!
ja: ただの植物が、なんでこんなことできるんだよ?!

key: This crack just opened up out of nowhere when shit went down!
en: This crack just opened up out of nowhere when shit went down!
ja: あの騒ぎが起きた時、この亀裂も突然できたんだ!

key: <>- Main Street\nv - 10th Street
en: <>- Main Street\nv - 10th Street
ja: <>- メインストリート\nv - 10番通り

key: Just step AWAY from the park.
en: Just step AWAY from the park.
ja: とにかく公園から離れてください。

key: Everyone, please remain calm. We have the situation under control!
en: Everyone, please remain calm. We have the situation under control!
ja: 皆さん、落ち着いてください。事態は制御下にあります!

key: In a manner of speaking...
en: In a manner of speaking...
ja: まあ、一応はな……

key: "Yureyu Corporate Headquarters"
en: "Yureyu Corporate Headquarters"
ja: 「ユレユ本部」

key: You probably don't wanna go down this way.
en: You probably don't wanna go down this way.
ja: この先には、あんまり行きたくないと思うぜ。

key: There's nothing down there but the slums. Bad news all around.
en: There's nothing down there but the slums. Bad news all around.
ja: あっちには、スラムしかない。ろくなことにならないぜ。

key: I wouldn't waste your time, bud.
en: I wouldn't waste your time, bud.
ja: 時間の無駄だと思うぜ、相棒。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
